positive_artifacts.normalisation: Published bytes differ from the emitted bytes by trailing whitespace only. The publishing repository's pre-commit gate runs end-of-file-fixer and trailing-whitespace over every committed file, including this evidence tree. Equality was PROVEN, not assumed: JSON artifacts were parsed and compared as objects; text artifacts were compared with trailing whitespace stripped. sha256_as_emitted is what the producer wrote; sha256_as_published is what verifies against the copy in this repository.

positive_result.command: l9-assurance evidence admit --subject <derived from SDK observation> --input <SDK observation> --output <dir>

evidence.producer_output_is_real: Observation projected by `l9-ci observation project-mandatory-findings` from a FindingBundle normalized by SDK code from a real semgrep 1.176.1 report.
evidence.consumer_is_real: Admission performed by the l9-assurance CLI's evidence.admit route (AssuranceEngine.admit).

evidence.audit_regression_closed: The original audit found Assurance rejected the SDK's artifact.sdkVersion field and producer trust was inactive. Both now behave correctly: the real field is accepted and an out-of-range version is rejected as EVIDENCE_PRODUCER_VERSION_REVOKED.
